notes.title: Spiriat Update
notes.content: Hello community, we have solved some bugs, now you will be able to change the difficulty within each level.  We have also discovered and solved a big bug in the last build, where it didn't allow you to reach the credits.  We apologize to all Spiriat players.

tags.feature: now you will be able to change the difficulty within each level.

tags.bug: We have also discovered and solved a big bug in the last build, where it didn't allow you to reach the credits.

notes.title: Spiriat Update 1.2
notes.content: Hello everyone! Good morning! We want to share the latest news about Spiriat. In our new 1.2 update, we've fixed bugs, added an "Easy" difficulty level, and optimized the menu loading. We're also working on a new mode for those who have unlocked all the stories in "Normal" mode, featuring a leaderboard showcasing the best records for time and collected orbs, which will update locally or online. Thank you for your support and for playing our first video game, Spiriat! 🌟🎮

tags.feature: We're also working on a new mode for those who have unlocked all the stories in "Normal" mode, featuring a leaderboard showcasing the best records for time and collected orbs, which will update locally or online.
